# `@videojs/spf/hls/features/shift-text-timestamps`

Source: [src/playback/engines/hls/features/shift-text-timestamps.ts](../../../src/playback/engines/hls/features/shift-text-timestamps.ts)

## shiftTextTimestampsFeature

Shifts text cues onto the playlist's zero-based timeline along with the audio and video, rebasing each cue by the
shift `shiftTimestampsFeature` establishes. Does nothing without a text feature, such as `textTracksFeature`.

Requires a writer of each track's `startMediaTime` from its container timestamps, such as `shiftTimestampsFeature`;
without one, cues wait for an origin nothing establishes and never appear.

### Behaviors

None.

### Config

| Key | Type | Default | Read by | Doc |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `textMessagePipelines` | `TextMessagePipelines<VTTCue>` | `relocatingTextPipelines` | [setupTextTrackActors](../behaviors/dom/setup-text-track-actors.md#setuptexttrackactors) | Ordered text step pipeline, mapped to the loader's `messagePipelines`. Named with the `text` domain prefix to mirror the v/a `video`/`audioMessagePipelines` composition-config slots. Defaults (in the loader) to `resolveCues → dispatchCues`. |
